summary: Migrated repo has no data/store rows: probe_store_shape on vaastav_player_gameweek_stats returned EMPTY. Committed E7 gate results and the 2023-24 decision log remain available, but new three-season real-store reruns require restoring the historical store or rebuilding it from public archive data.
Supersedes the prior empty-store observation: data/store is now populated and 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26 each load all 38 rounds. A full 2023-24 S10b pilot was therefore attempted.

Full 2023-24 pilot aborted at GW23 because the S10b reconciliation guard found optimiser diagnostic hit points -8 versus replay -4. Root cause was a real MILP accounting defect: hits_t had only a lower bound but also fed the next-round FT recurrence, allowing an inflated current hit to manufacture a future FT at equal total horizon hit cost. User explicitly authorised the fix. Added a fail-first synthetic regression that reproduced 2 solver hits where the real ledger requires 1, then enforced hits_t == max(0, transfers_t - FT_t) with an exact binary big-M linearisation. Hit-cost coefficients/objective unchanged. Validation after fix: focused optimiser/E7/S10b 104 passed, 8 deselected; full non-slow 1472 passed, 81 deselected. Full 2023-24 S10b rerun remains pending; prior E7 gate must be revalidated because H6 decisions may have used invalid future FT plans.
